Door has no narrow frosted-glass strip, unlike the adjoining LOC11 burgundy service-door design; cross-set doorway continuity needs reconciliation.
Keep the strong luxury material design; lock southwest service door and table/booth axis consistently across plan, south elevation and wides before shooting.
